title: Cyan attention accent (speculative)
description: SPECULATIVE — not recommended over the current palette; default remains to keep the existing amber. Re-defines the attention hue (--color-accent-text / --color-amber-500) as a restrained cyan instead of amber. Shown for comparison only: cyan sits close to the existing blue-400 (#5ca1d6) brand/demo hue on the color wheel, so it risks blurring the "attention vs. brand/demo" distinction the COLOR RULE is meant to preserve (amber = attention, blue = demo/brand). Included as an exploration, not a suggestion.

changes.intent: Explore a cyan attention accent as an alternative to amber; flagged as competing with the existing blue brand/demo hue.
changes.detail: Dark theme values shown above (kiosk default). For light theme, --color-accent-text would need a darker cyan such as #0e7d85 to stay legible on white per the existing light-theme override pattern. Speculative and NOT recommended: risks visual confusion with the blue-400 demo badge / brand color already on screen. Default is to keep current amber (#ffd24e / #ffc107).
